purpose: Source-backed browser acceptance replicas. Provider names and URLs are test metadata only and are not used by production planning logic.

Live application exposed Resume/CV, Full name, Email, Phone, Current location/company, LinkedIn, education questions, project ownership question, visa question and Submit application.

Current live Workday listing exposed the initial Apply control. Later Apply Manually/authentication stages are provider-pattern replicas used only to test generic navigation and authentication pause behaviour.
Current live Ashby listing exposed Apply for this Job. The application fields are a provider-pattern replica used to exercise the generic start CTA and single-page form behaviour.
Current official SmartRecruiters posting anchors the test. Application controls are a provider-pattern replica used to exercise generic start, upload, checkbox and final-review handling.
